from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
from decimal import Decimal
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import json,hashlib,re,pandas as pd
root=Path.cwd(); out=root/'reports/research/510300_treasury_borrowing_revision_panel_v1'
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def save(name,obj):(out/name).write_text(json.dumps(obj,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
protocol=json.loads((out/'protocol.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
freeze=json.loads((out/'freeze.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert sha(out/'protocol.json')==freeze['protocol_sha256']
assert not (out/'result.json').exists(),'已有结果，不覆盖冻结实验。'
receipts=json.loads((out/'release_receipts.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))['receipts']
tables=json.loads((out/'table_receipts.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))['receipts']
pdfs={x['quarter']:x for x in json.loads((out/'所有原PDF页面文字.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))}
dates={x['quarter']:x for x in json.loads((out/'actual_release_metadata.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))}
releases={x['quarter']:x for x in receipts}; table_byq={x['quarter']:x for x in tables}
for rec in receipts+tables:assert sha(root/rec['path'])==rec['sha256']
quarters=protocol['fixed_current_quarters']
assert len(quarters)==16 and len(receipts)==17 and len(tables)==16
monthpairs={1:('January','March'),2:('April','June'),3:('July','September'),4:('October','December')}
def amount(text,pattern):
    m=re.search(pattern,text);assert m,(pattern,text)
    n=Decimal(m.group(1).replace(',',''))*(Decimal(1000) if len(m.groups())>=2 and m.group(2)=='trillion' else Decimal(1))
    assert n==n.to_integral_value(),'保留源精度，不强制取整'
    return int(n)
def norm(s):return re.sub(r'\s*[\u2013\u2014-]\s*',' - ',' '.join(s.split()))
bodyparts={}; excerpts=[]
for q,rec in releases.items():
    soup=BeautifulSoup((root/rec['path']).read_bytes(),'html.parser')
    full=norm(soup.get_text(' ',strip=True)); start=full.index('WASHINGTON')
    end=full.index('Additional financing details',start)
    body=full[start:end]
    parts=re.split(r'(?=During the\b)',body)
    bodyparts[q]=[x.strip() for x in parts if x.startswith('During the')]
    excerpts.append({'release_quarter':q,'body_date':dates[q]['body_date_text'],'url':rec['url'],'body_before_refunding_notice':body})
def get_part(release_q,target_q,actual=False):
    y=int(target_q[:4]);k=int(target_q[-1]);m1,m2=monthpairs[k]
    prefix=f'During the {m1} - {m2} {y} quarter'
    hits=[s for s in bodyparts[release_q] if s.startswith(prefix) and ('Treasury borrowed' in s if actual else 'Treasury expects to' in s)]
    assert len(hits)==1,(release_q,target_q,actual,hits)
    return hits[0]
def debt_and_cash(s):
    if 'expects to pay down' in s: borrowing=-amount(s,r'expects to pay down \$([\d,.]+)\s+(billion|trillion)')
    else:borrowing=amount(s,r'expects to borrow \$([\d,.]+)\s+(billion|trillion)')
    cash=amount(s,r'cash balance of \$([\d,.]+)\s+(billion|trillion)')
    return borrowing,cash
def prev_q(q):
    y=int(q[:4]);k=int(q[-1]);return f'{y}Q{k-1}' if k>1 else f'{y-1}Q4'
def nums(s):
    tokens=re.findall(r'\(?-?[\d,]+\)?',s);assert len(tokens)==7,s
    return [(-int(x[1:-1].replace(',','')) if x.startswith('(') else int(x.replace(',',''))) for x in tokens]
def table_row(line):
    m=re.search(r'([A-Za-z]+ \d{1,2}, \d{4})\s+(.+)$',line)
    assert m,line
    return {'printed_date':m.group(1),'values':nums(m.group(2)),'raw_line':line}
panel=[];rawrows=[];coverage=[]
for q in quarters:
    prior=prev_q(q);current=get_part(q,q);old=get_part(prior,q)
    b0,end0=debt_and_cash(old);b1,end1=debt_and_cash(current)
    _,start0=debt_and_cash(get_part(prior,prior))
    actual=get_part(q,prior,actual=True)
    start1=amount(actual,r'cash balance of \$([\d,.]+)\s+(billion|trillion)')
    revmatch=re.search(r'borrowing estimate is \$([\d,.]+) billion (higher|lower)',current)
    assert revmatch,(q,current)
    rev=int(Decimal(revmatch.group(1).replace(',','')))*(1 if revmatch.group(2)=='higher' else -1)
    d0=datetime.strptime(dates[q]['body_date_text'],'%B %d, %Y')
    available=d0.replace(hour=23,minute=59,second=59,tzinfo=ZoneInfo('America/New_York')).astimezone(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()
    record={'quarter':q,'actual_release_date':d0.date().isoformat(),'known_at_conservative_proxy_shanghai':available,
        'prior_actual_release_date':datetime.strptime(dates[prior]['body_date_text'],'%B %d, %Y').date().isoformat(),
        'prior_private_borrowing_billion_usd':b0,'current_private_borrowing_billion_usd':b1,
        'displayed_borrowing_pair_delta':b1-b0,'reported_borrowing_revision_billion_usd':rev,
        'reported_minus_display_pair_delta':rev-(b1-b0),
        'prior_start_cash_assumption':start0,'current_actual_start_cash':start1,
        'prior_end_cash_target':end0,'current_end_cash_target':end1,
        'start_cash_contribution':start0-start1,'end_cash_target_contribution':end1-end0,
        'cash_contribution_total':start0-start1+end1-end0,
        'cash_adjusted_borrowing_revision_not_financing_need':rev-(start0-start1+end1-end0),
        'source_url':releases[q]['url'],'source_path':releases[q]['path'],'source_sha256':releases[q]['sha256'],
        'current_support_table_path':table_byq[q]['path'],'current_support_table_sha256':table_byq[q]['sha256'],
        'notes_debt_limit_conditional':'debt limit' in BeautifulSoup((root/releases[q]['path']).read_bytes(),'html.parser').get_text(' ',strip=True).lower(),
        'financing_need_revision_reported':None,'all_other_sources_revision_reported':None,
        'other_sources_borrowing_contribution':None,'soma_memo_revision_reported':None,
        'decomposition_display_residual':None,'table_prior_date_label_matches_prior_actual_body':None,
        'current_table_three_rows_available':False,'table_current_date_matches_actual_body':None,
        'budget_projection_change_stated_in_body':None,
        'source_status':None}
    budget_match=re.search(r'(?:projections of lower receipts and higher outlays)\s*\(\$([\d,.]+) billion\)',current)
    if budget_match:record['budget_projection_change_stated_in_body']=int(Decimal(budget_match.group(1).replace(',','')))
    if q in pdfs:
        text=pdfs[q]['pages'][0]['text'];lines=text.splitlines()
        ix=[i for i,s in enumerate(lines) if dates[q]['body_date_text'] in s and i+1<len(lines) and re.match(r'^(?:Forecast )?Revisions\s+',lines[i+1]) and i>0 and re.search(r'[A-Za-z]+ \d{1,2}, \d{4}',lines[i-1])]
        assert len(ix)==1,(q,ix)
        i=ix[0];oldr=table_row(lines[i-1]);newr=table_row(lines[i]);rr=nums(re.sub(r'^(?:Forecast )?Revisions\s+','',lines[i+1]))
        assert newr['values'][1]==b1 and oldr['values'][1]==b0 and newr['values'][5]==end1 and oldr['values'][5]==end0,(q,oldr,newr)
        assert rr[1]==rev,(q,rr,rev)
        record.update(current_table_three_rows_available=True,
            table_prior_date_label_matches_prior_actual_body=oldr['printed_date']==dates[prior]['body_date_text'],
            table_current_date_matches_actual_body=newr['printed_date']==dates[q]['body_date_text'],
            printed_prior_date_label=oldr['printed_date'],printed_current_date_label=newr['printed_date'],
            financing_need_revision_reported=rr[0],all_other_sources_revision_reported=rr[2],
            other_sources_borrowing_contribution=-rr[2],soma_memo_revision_reported=rr[6],
            financing_need_revision_display_pair=newr['values'][0]-oldr['values'][0],
            all_other_sources_revision_display_pair=newr['values'][2]-oldr['values'][2])
        record['decomposition_display_residual']=rev-record['cash_contribution_total']-rr[0]+rr[2]
        record['source_status']='FIELDS_AND_ACTUAL_BODY_DATES_ALIGNED' if record['table_prior_date_label_matches_prior_actual_body'] else 'FIELDS_AVAILABLE_PRIOR_DATE_LABEL_DISCREPANCY'
        keys=['financing_need','marketable_borrowing','all_other_sources','total','cash_balance_change','end_cash_balance','soma_redemptions_memo']
        for kind,row in [('prior_forecast_in_current_table',oldr),('current_forecast',newr),('reported_revision',{'printed_date':None,'values':rr,'raw_line':lines[i+1]})]:
            rawrows.append({'current_release_quarter':q,'row_kind':kind,'printed_date':row['printed_date'],'actual_current_release_date':record['actual_release_date'],
                **dict(zip(keys,row['values'])),'raw_line':row['raw_line'],'source_pdf':table_byq[q]['path'],'page':1})
    else:
        assert q=='2023Q2' and table_byq[q]['path'].endswith('.png')
        record['source_status']='CASH_ONLY_IMAGE_FINANCING_FIELDS_MISSING'
        record['missing_fields']='当前原表同季度Financing Need与All Other Sources两预估/修订行；SOMA memo两预估'
        record['image_manual_read_current_q2']={'prior_opening_cash':500,'current_opening_cash':178,'opening_change':-322,
            'prior_closing_cash':550,'current_closing_cash':550,'closing_change':0,'impact_on_borrowing_prior':50,'impact_on_borrowing_current':372,'impact_change':322}
        assert (start0,start1,end0,end1)==(500,178,550,550)
    panel.append(record)
    coverage.append({'quarter':q,'release_saved':True,'table_saved':True,'table_format':'PDF' if q in pdfs else 'PNG',
        'three_same_quarter_rows':record['current_table_three_rows_available'],
        'current_table_date_aligned':record['table_current_date_matches_actual_body'],
        'prior_table_date_aligned':record['table_prior_date_label_matches_prior_actual_body'],
        'status':record['source_status']})
save('原公告字段及原因记录.json',panel)
save('原公告正文范围.json',excerpts)
pd.DataFrame([{k:v for k,v in x.items() if not isinstance(v,dict)} for x in panel]).to_csv(out/'16季度借款修订原因面板_缺项保留.csv',index=False,encoding='utf-8-sig')
pd.DataFrame(rawrows).to_csv(out/'15份原PDF的同季度两预估及修订行.csv',index=False,encoding='utf-8-sig')
pd.DataFrame(coverage).to_csv(out/'16季度来源覆盖与缺口.csv',index=False,encoding='utf-8-sig')

date_mismatch=[x['quarter'] for x in panel if x['table_prior_date_label_matches_prior_actual_body'] is False]

    'source_first_vintage_certified':False,'historic_actual_receipt_time_certified':False,'display_precision_unrounded_identity_certified':False,
    'equity_labels_loaded':False,'model_registration_created':False,'models_fitted':0,'accounts_simulated':0}
assert not full,'若来源通过，另登记模型；不得在本源程序内继续。'
